q21302.en: The sign shown indicates the distance to the exit junction for the place shown.

explain.short: The green part says PIACENZA 4: the exit for Piacenza is 4 km ahead.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'svincolo d'uscita' means the exit junction: its distance is the number on the right, 4.

sceneParams.caption: Exit for Piacenza in 4 km

q21303.en: The sign shown is placed along a motorway.

explain.short: Green is the colour of motorway signs, so this sign stands along a motorway.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'autostrada' (motorway): the green background tells you.

sceneParams.caption: Green background = motorway

q21304.en: The sign shown indicates on the left the progressive distance and on the right the distance to the exit toll booth for Piacenza.

explain.short: The white box on the left is km 54 of the motorway; the green part on the right is 4 km to the Piacenza exit.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'casello d'uscita' (exit toll booth) is the exit where you leave the motorway.

sceneParams.caption: Left: km 54. Right: Piacenza exit in 4 km

q21305.en: The sign shown, in its left part, indicates the progressive distance from the starting point of the motorway.

explain.short: 54 means you are 54 km from the point where the motorway begins.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'luogo di origine' means the starting point of the motorway, where km 0 is.

sceneParams.caption: Km 54 from the start of the motorway

q21306.en: The sign shown indicates that there are 4 kilometres to go to the exit toll booth for Piacenza.

explain.short: PIACENZA 4 means 4 more km to the Piacenza exit.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'mancano' means 'are left to go': 4 km still to drive, not 4 km done.

sceneParams.caption: 4 km to the Piacenza exit

q21307.en: The sign shown is one of the information signs.

explain.short: It gives information (km and exits); it does not give an order or warn of danger.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'segnali di indicazione' means information signs: no danger, no obligation.

sceneParams.caption: An information sign

q21308.en: The sign shown indicates that there are 54 kilometres to go to the exit junction for Piacenza.

explain.short: 54 is the progressive km of the motorway; the Piacenza exit is only 4 km away.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: '54' is in the white box (km marker), not next to PIACENZA. (The official text has a typo: 'cha' = 'che'.)

sceneParams.caption: 54 = km marker; Piacenza exit is 4 km away

q21309.en: The sign shown indicates that you are travelling on motorway no. 54.

explain.short: 54 is a distance in km from the start of the motorway, not the motorway's number.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'autostrada n. 54' (motorway no. 54): motorway numbers start with A (like A1); this 54 is kilometres.

sceneParams.caption: 54 is km, not the motorway number

q21310.en: The sign shown indicates on the left the recommended speed.

explain.short: The left number is the progressive km, not a speed.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'velocità consigliata' (recommended speed) has its own square blue sign; this 54 is km.

sceneParams.caption: Left number = km, not a speed

q21311.en: The sign shown indicates that 4 kilometres have already been travelled from Piacenza.

explain.short: The 4 km are still ahead: the Piacenza exit is coming, you have not passed it.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'già percorsi' (already travelled) is wrong: the 4 km are still to go.

sceneParams.caption: 4 km TO Piacenza, not from it

q21312.en: The sign shown indicates the start of a built-up area.

explain.short: The start of a town is a white sign with the town's name; this green sign is a motorway distance sign.
explain.rule: Green = motorway. Left white box: km 54 from the start of the motorway (progressive distance). Right: the Piacenza exit is 4 km ahead.
explain.trap: 'inizio di un centro abitato' (start of a town): no, this sign is on a motorway.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway km sign, not a town sign

q21313.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area for taxis on duty.

explain.short: It marks the place where working taxis stop and wait for customers.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'in servizio' means on duty, taxis that are working.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi stand: taxis on duty only

q21314.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area for the exclusive use of taxis on duty.

explain.short: Only taxis on duty may park there; other cars may not.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'ad uso esclusivo' means only for them, nobody else.

sceneParams.caption: Only taxis on duty may park here

q21315.en: The sign shown indicates a parking place reserved for taxis on duty.

explain.short: 'Parcheggio riservato' is another way to say the area is only for taxis on duty.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'riservato' (reserved) means other vehicles cannot use it.

sceneParams.caption: Parking reserved for taxis

q21316.en: The sign shown indicates an area marked with yellow lines with the word TAXI.

explain.short: On the ground the taxi area is marked by yellow lines and the word TAXI.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'strisce gialle' (yellow lines) mark reserved spaces, like taxi spaces.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow lines and TAXI on the ground

q21317.en: The sign shown indicates no overtaking for taxis.

explain.short: It is about a parking place for taxis; it says nothing about overtaking.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking) is a round red sign with two cars.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi parking, not a no-overtaking sign

q21318.en: The sign shown indicates a road closed to taxis.

explain.short: It shows where taxis CAN park; it does not close a road to them.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'strada vietata' (road closed) would be a round red sign.

sceneParams.caption: Taxis may park here, road not closed

q21319.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a device nearby for calling a taxi.

explain.short: It marks a taxi parking area, not a phone or call box for taxis.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'apparecchio per chiamare' (a device to call): the sign shows no phone.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi parking, not a taxi call box

q21320.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a taxi radio station.

explain.short: It only marks a taxi parking area; it says nothing about radio.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'stazione radio' (radio station) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi parking, not a radio station

q21321.en: The sign shown has its own light.

explain.short: It is a normal painted sign; it does not light up by itself.
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'luce propria' (its own light): this sign has no lamp inside.

sceneParams.caption: A normal sign, no light of its own

q21322.en: The sign shown indicates a garage reserved for taxis.

explain.short: It marks a parking area on the street, not a garage (a closed building).
explain.rule: The TAXI sign marks a parking area only for taxis on duty. Other vehicles may not park there.
explain.trap: 'garage' is a building; the taxi area is on the road.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi area on the street, not a garage

q21323.en: The sign shown indicates a public telephone point nearby.

explain.short: The handset symbol tells you there is a public phone close by.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'posto di telefono pubblico' means a place with a public phone.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone nearby

q21324.en: The sign shown indicates that we are near a public telephone.

explain.short: The sign tells you a public telephone is close to where you are.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'apparecchio telefonico' simply means a telephone.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone nearby

q21325.en: The sign shown indicates that, a short distance away, you can phone from a public telephone.

explain.short: A public phone is just ahead, so you can make a call there.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'a breve distanza' (a short distance away): the phone is close.

sceneParams.caption: You can call from a public phone ahead

q21326.en: The sign shown indicates a public telephone placed on roads outside towns.

explain.short: This blue service sign is used on roads outside towns, so it can mark a public phone there.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' means roads outside towns; the sign is used there.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone on a road outside town

q21327.en: The sign shown indicates that a mobile phone shop is nearby.

explain.short: It shows a public phone, not a shop that sells mobile phones.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'negozio di telefonia mobile' (mobile phone shop): road signs do not show shops.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone, not a phone shop

q21328.en: The sign shown indicates a first aid post that can be reached by phone.

explain.short: First aid has its own sign with a red cross; this one is only a public phone.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'pronto soccorso' (first aid) is not shown here.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone, not first aid

q21329.en: The sign shown indicates that you can recharge mobile phones.

explain.short: It shows a public phone; it says nothing about charging phones.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'ricaricare' (recharge): nothing about charging on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone, not phone charging

q21330.en: The sign shown indicates that using mobile phones is forbidden.

explain.short: It is an information sign, so it forbids nothing. A ban would be a round red sign.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'vietato' (forbidden): square blue signs give information, they do not ban.

sceneParams.caption: Information, not a ban on phones

q21331.en: The sign shown indicates an area with enough mobile phone signal.

explain.short: It is about a public phone, not about mobile network coverage.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'coperta dal segnale' (covered by signal): the sign says nothing about mobile signal.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone, not mobile coverage

q21332.en: The sign shown indicates that you may phone only with hands-free mobile phones.

explain.short: It sets no rule for mobile phones; it just shows a public phone.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a handset: a public telephone is close by. It is information only.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) and 'viva voce' (hands-free): the sign says nothing about mobiles.

sceneParams.caption: Public phone, no rule about mobiles

q21333.en: The sign shown indicates a fuel filling point.

explain.short: The fuel pump symbol marks a place where you can buy fuel.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'rifornimento' means filling up (the tank).

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station a short way ahead

q21334.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a fuel supply point nearby.

explain.short: The pump tells you a fuel station is close by.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'nelle vicinanze' (nearby): the station is close.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station a short way ahead

q21335.en: The sign shown indicates that you can get fuel a short distance away.

explain.short: A short way ahead there is a fuel station where you can fill up.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'a breve distanza' (a short distance away): the station is close.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station a short way ahead

q21336.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a fuel station a short distance away.

explain.short: The pump symbol means a fuel station a short way ahead.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'stazione di rifornimento' is another name for a fuel station.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station a short way ahead

q21337.en: The sign shown indicates that along the road, a short distance away, there is a fuel pump station.

explain.short: A fuel station is on this road, a short way ahead.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'distributore di carburante' means fuel station.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station a short way ahead

q21338.en: The sign shown indicates a mechanical repair workshop nearby.

explain.short: A repair workshop has its own sign with a spanner; this pump means fuel.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'officina' (repair workshop): the pump means fuel, not repairs.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station, not a repair workshop

q21339.en: The sign shown indicates a public telephone point nearby.

explain.short: The phone sign shows a handset; this one shows a fuel pump.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'posto telefonico' (phone point): the symbol is a pump, not a handset.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel pump, not a telephone

q21340.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a parking area for motor vehicles nearby.

explain.short: Parking is shown with a P; this sign shows a fuel pump.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'area di sosta' (parking area) has the P sign, not a pump.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station, not parking

q21341.en: The sign shown indicates a fuel station reserved only for vehicles running on LPG.

explain.short: It is a normal fuel station for all vehicles; nothing on it says GPL (LPG gas).
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): nothing on the sign limits it to GPL.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel for all, not only GPL

q21342.en: The sign shown indicates a refinery.

explain.short: A refinery is a factory that makes fuel; this sign means a place to buy fuel.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'raffineria' (refinery, a fuel factory) is not a fuel station.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel station, not a refinery

q21343.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying fuel from passing.

explain.short: It bans nothing; it is information. Bans are round red signs.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a fuel pump: you can get fuel a short distance ahead. Information only.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (bans traffic): square blue signs never ban.

sceneParams.caption: Information only, it bans nothing

q21344.en: The sign shown is an advance warning of a temporary detour.

explain.short: Yellow means temporary: it warns of a detour you will meet ahead.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'temporanea' (temporary): yellow signs are for roadworks and stay only for a while.

sceneParams.caption: Detour ahead because of roadworks

q21345.en: The sign shown warns in advance that a road is closed for roadworks.

explain.short: The road is blocked by works (the triangle on the arrow), so traffic is sent around it.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'interruzione' (closure): the straight road is cut, the detour goes around.

sceneParams.caption: Road closed for works: detour

q21346.en: The sign shown is one of the temporary signs for roadworks.

explain.short: A yellow background means a temporary sign for roadworks.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'segnali temporanei' (temporary signs) have a yellow background.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign

q21347.en: The sign shown indicates in its bottom part the length of the detour.

explain.short: The bottom panel '2 km', with arrows at both ends, tells you how long the detour is.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'lunghezza' (length): 2 km is how long the detour is, not how far away.

sceneParams.caption: Detour is 2 km long

q21348.en: The sign shown indicates that it is absolutely impossible to reach Novara.

explain.short: Novara can still be reached: the detour goes around the works and back to the road.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'assolutamente' (absolutely) is an extreme word; the arrow still arrives at Novara.

sceneParams.caption: Novara is reached by the detour

q21349.en: The sign shown obliges you to turn back.

explain.short: You go around the works, not back the way you came.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'tornare indietro' (turn back): the arrow goes forward, around the works.

sceneParams.caption: Go around the works, not back

q21350.en: The sign shown indicates a lay-by.

explain.short: It warns of a detour for roadworks; there is no stopping place on it.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'piazzola di sosta' (lay-by, a small place to stop) is not shown here.

sceneParams.caption: Detour for works, not a lay-by

q21351.en: The sign shown indicates the distance to a service area.

explain.short: The 2 km is the length of the detour; there is no service area on the sign.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'area di servizio' (service area) is not on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: 2 km = detour length, no service area

q21352.en: The sign shown indicates a worksite 2 kilometres long.

explain.short: The 2 km is the length of the detour, not of the worksite.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'cantiere' (worksite): the 2 km refers to the detour, not the works.

sceneParams.caption: 2 km = detour length, not worksite

q21353.en: The sign shown is placed 2 kilometres from the roadworks sign.

explain.short: The 2 km panel gives the length of the detour, not where the sign stands.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'posto a 2 chilometri' (placed 2 km away): 2 km is a length, not a position.

sceneParams.caption: 2 km = detour length, not sign position

q21354.en: The sign shown indicates that the detour is 2 kilometres away from the sign.

explain.short: The panel with arrows at both ends gives the length of the detour, not its distance.
explain.rule: Yellow = temporary roadworks sign. It warns of a detour around closed road; the bottom panel (2 km) is the length of the detour.
explain.trap: 'a 2 chilometri di distanza' (2 km away): the panel gives a length, not a distance.

sceneParams.caption: 2 km long, not 2 km away

q21355.en: The sign shown warns in advance of a junction in town.

explain.short: The white background means urban roads, and the arrows show a junction ahead.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'incrocio urbano' (junction in town): the white background means urban.

sceneParams.caption: Junction in town ahead

q21356.en: The sign shown gives the names of the places that can be reached from the junction in town.

explain.short: Sora, Napoli, centre and station are the places you reach from that junction.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'raggiungibili' means 'that can be reached'.

sceneParams.caption: Places reached from the junction

q21357.en: The sign shown warns in advance of the right turn to reach the railway station.

explain.short: 'stazione' with a small train symbol is on the right arrow.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'stazione ferroviaria' (railway station): the small train symbol marks it.

sceneParams.caption: Right for the railway station

q21358.en: The sign shown warns in advance of the right turn to reach the city centre.

explain.short: 'centro' with its round symbol is on the right arrow.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'centro della città' (city centre): written 'centro' with a bullseye symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Right for the city centre

q21359.en: The sign shown indicates to go straight on to reach Sora.

explain.short: Sora is on the blue panel at the top of the straight arrow.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' means continue straight on.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on for Sora

q21360.en: The sign shown warns in advance to go straight on to reach Napoli.

explain.short: Napoli is on the blue panel at the top of the straight arrow.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' means continue straight on.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on for Napoli

q21361.en: The sign shown is found on roads outside towns.

explain.short: The white background is for urban roads; outside towns direction signs are blue.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' (roads outside towns): the white background means in town.

sceneParams.caption: White = in town, not outside

q21362.en: The sign shown indicates to turn right to leave the built-up area.

explain.short: Right leads to the centre and the station, which are inside the town.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'uscire dal centro abitato' (leave the town): right goes to the centre.

sceneParams.caption: Right goes to the centre, not out of town

q21363.en: The sign shown indicates that to reach the city centre you must turn back.

explain.short: The centre is to the right; no arrow points back.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'tornare indietro' (turn back): no arrow on the sign points back.

sceneParams.caption: Centre is to the right, not behind

q21364.en: The sign shown warns in advance of a parking area on the right.

explain.short: On the right you find the centre and the station, not a parking area.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'area di sosta' (parking area) would show a P; here: centre and station.

sceneParams.caption: Right: centre and station, no parking

q21365.en: The sign shown warns in advance of a level crossing without barriers on the right.

explain.short: The small train next to 'stazione' marks the railway station, not a level crossing.
explain.rule: White = urban direction sign. Junction ahead: straight for Sora and Napoli, right for the centre and the station.
explain.trap: 'passaggio a livello' (level crossing) is a danger sign; the train here means the station.

sceneParams.caption: Train symbol = station, not level crossing

q21366.en: The sign shown warns in advance of two junctions close together.

explain.short: The arrow crosses two side roads: two junctions one after the other.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'due incroci vicini' (two close junctions): count the crossings on the arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Two junctions close together

q21367.en: The sign shown indicates that you cannot turn left at the first junction.

explain.short: At the first (lower) junction the left side has the red no-entry disc.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'primo incrocio' (first junction) is the lower one, with the no-entry disc.

sceneParams.caption: 1st junction: no left turn

q21368.en: The sign shown warns in advance to turn left for the hospital at the second junction.

explain.short: 'ospedale' is on the left at the second (upper) junction.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'secondo incrocio' (second junction) is the upper one.

sceneParams.caption: 2nd junction: left for the hospital

q21369.en: The sign shown warns in advance to turn right for via Gemona at the first junction.

explain.short: 'via Gemona' is on the right at the first (lower) junction.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'via Gemona' is a street name, written small next to the first junction.

sceneParams.caption: 1st junction: right for via Gemona

q21370.en: The sign shown warns in advance to turn right for the city centre at the second junction.

explain.short: 'centro' is on the right at the second (upper) junction.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'secondo incrocio' (second junction) is the upper one.

sceneParams.caption: 2nd junction: right for the centre

q21371.en: The sign shown warns in advance to turn right towards Trieste at the second junction.

explain.short: Trieste is on the blue panel on the right, at the second junction.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'in direzione' means towards.

sceneParams.caption: 2nd junction: right for Trieste

q21372.en: The sign shown indicates that you must turn left at the second junction to reach Austria.

explain.short: Austria is on the blue panel on the left, at the second junction.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'secondo incrocio' (second junction): the first left is no entry.

sceneParams.caption: 2nd junction: left for Austria

q21373.en: The sign shown indicates two close junctions on an urban road.

explain.short: The white background means an urban road, and two junctions are drawn.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'strada urbana' (road in town): the white background tells you.

sceneParams.caption: Two junctions on an urban road

q21374.en: The sign shown is found on roads outside towns.

explain.short: The white background is for urban roads; outside towns direction signs are blue.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' (roads outside towns): the white background means in town.

sceneParams.caption: White = in town, not outside

q21375.en: The sign shown indicates how to leave vehicles parked.

explain.short: It shows directions at two junctions, nothing about parking.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'lasciare in sosta' (leave parked): the sign is about directions, not parking.

sceneParams.caption: Directions, not parking

q21376.en: The sign shown tells vehicles going to Austria to turn back.

explain.short: For Austria you turn left at the second junction; no arrow points back.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'tornare indietro' (turn back): Austria is reached at the second left.

sceneParams.caption: Austria: left at the 2nd junction

q21377.en: The sign shown allows you to turn left at the first junction.

explain.short: The red no-entry disc on the first left means you may NOT turn left there.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows): the no-entry disc forbids that turn.

sceneParams.caption: 1st junction: left is NO ENTRY

q21378.en: The sign shown indicates how to exit a shopping centre.

explain.short: It gives road directions in town; 'centro' here means the city centre.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'centro commerciale' (shopping centre): 'centro' on the sign is the city centre.

sceneParams.caption: Town directions, not a shopping centre

q21379.en: The sign shown announces the directions for the motorway entrance.

explain.short: Motorway directions are on green panels; here the panels are blue and white.
explain.rule: Two junctions close together. 1st: left no entry, right via Gemona. 2nd: left Austria and hospital, right Trieste and centre.
explain.trap: 'autostrada' (motorway): there is no green panel on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: No green panel: no motorway
